question.knowledge_point: Applying the Limit Definition of the Exponential Function
question.worked_solution:
Recall the following special limit: 

$$
{e}^{x}={lim}_{n\to \infty }{(1+\frac{x}{n})}^{n}
$$

Now, we rewrite the given limit using the algebra of limits, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{n\to \infty }{(1+\frac{x}{n})}^{n{y}^{2}} & ={lim}_{n\to \infty }{[{(1+\frac{x}{n})}^{n}]}^{{y}^{2}} \\  & ={[{lim}_{n\to \infty }{(1+\frac{x}{n})}^{n}]}^{{y}^{2}} \\  & ={({e}^{x})}^{{y}^{2}} \\  & ={e}^{x{y}^{2}}\end{aligned}
$$
